status: Proposed monitoring definitions; not approved or preregistered forecasts
relationship: Supplements ../forecast-questions.json. Does not replace questionnaire pillar/year cells or official food-safety approval questions.
baseline: No qualifying domestic cultivated-product certificate was established in this bounded corpus; absence has not been proved.
start_rule: Before preregistration, set T0 to the next local calendar day after the approved question-file commit. Count only newly issued records in T0 through the cutoff. Do not silently backfill T0.

common_rules.event_scope: Human-food cultivated animal meat, including an explicitly covered cultivated ingredient in a hybrid. The original record must identify animal-cell culture; plant analogues, whole cloned animals and pet-only products do not qualify.
certificate_requirements: Original issuing-body public certificate or issuer registry entry, not an applicant press release
Named certificate ID, dated issuance and validity covering the cutoff
Named manufacturer and manufacturing site in the specified country
Explicit cultivated-product/process scope; generic meat, bioculture, enzyme or facility certification alone is insufficient
Check issuing-body status and any suspension or revocation applicable at the cutoff; retain the original records
common_rules.source_hierarchy: Issuing-body original certificate plus relevant official certifier-status record; then issuer clarification of scope. Newspaper, manufacturer or foreign council reports are leads only. A foreign certificate alone does not satisfy the named domestic-body event.
common_rules.resolution: YES only with the complete original records. NO requires a sufficiently complete official record/search for the defined publication event; never infer NO solely from an inaccessible page. Missing scope, incomplete registers, inaccessible originals, conflicting validity or unresolved translation produces UNRESOLVED with reasons.
common_rules.retrieval_limit: At most three failed retrievals per source, then preserve the gap.
common_rules.interpretation: Certification observables do not establish food-safety authorization, legal market access, sales, demand or market share. Horizon pairs concern the same event and are dependent.

certification_signposts.question: By 31 December 2030, will Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind Halal Trust have issued a publicly verifiable halal certificate explicitly covering human-food cultivated meat manufactured at a named Indian site, valid at that cutoff?
certification_signposts.caveat: The reviewed scheme establishes a certification process, not a present cultivated certificate or accredited cultivated scope.

certification_signposts.question: By 31 December 2035, will Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind Halal Trust have issued a publicly verifiable halal certificate explicitly covering human-food cultivated meat manufactured at a named Indian site, valid at that cutoff?
certification_signposts.caveat: Same event as 2030 with a later horizon; not independent evidence.

certification_signposts.question: By 31 December 2030, will SANHA Halal Associates Pakistan have issued a publicly verifiable halal certificate explicitly covering human-food cultivated meat manufactured at a named Pakistani site, valid at that cutoff?
certification_signposts.caveat: PHA's captured row 7 registers the Pakistan body. This is not the South African body, a product certificate or proof of future scope.

certification_signposts.question: By 31 December 2035, will SANHA Halal Associates Pakistan have issued a publicly verifiable halal certificate explicitly covering human-food cultivated meat manufactured at a named Pakistani site, valid at that cutoff?
certification_signposts.caveat: Same event as 2030 with a later horizon; a current registration cannot prove future registration.

ai_observables.event: DBT or BIRAC publishes an original award and technical project report naming a Smart Proteins project that implements AI monitoring/predictive fermentation control with real process data and an identified comparison baseline.
required_fields: original official report URL and date
ai_observables.status: Monitoring checklist; a call objective alone never satisfies it.
ai_observables.interpretation_limit: No AI performance, resource allocation payoff, cost saving or halal determination inferred before the report is reviewed.

ai_observables.event: A named domestic certifier publishes a versioned procedure specifying how AI-generated ingredient/process evidence is checked by qualified technical and religious reviewers, with accountability and source-trace requirements.
ai_observables.status: Proposed observable; no such AI-specific certifier procedure established in the reviewed corpus.
ai_observables.interpretation_limit: IFA's general AI resolution does not itself authorize automated certification. Human-reviewed protocol publication would not establish any product certificate.
